---
title: "A page with image false keeps the site image and its size"
image: false
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="mark.jpg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="892">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">'
        - []
---

`image: false` does not replace the site image, so the size declared for it still applies.
